findings.citation_text: Moreover, MoiréVision [40] introduces a generalized 6-DoF motion sensing mechanism based on moiré patterns, addressing the limitations of traditional moiré-based methods under perspective distortion and dimensional interference. Compared with our acoustic-based approach, MoiréVision is camera-dependent and may be sensitive to lighting and occlusion, while our system ensures privacy and robustness in visually constrained environments. These complementary characteristics highlight different design trade-offs in high-precision 6-DoF tracking.
